note: The claimed value uses 'action-ref:v2:' -- the generic, spec-unnamed prefix RFC 002 explicitly considered and rejected in favor of a spec-named tag ('mycelium.action-ref:v2:'). A generic version-only prefix does not close the cross-protocol collision this vector set exists to catch: any other protocol that also decides to call its own domain tag 'action-ref:v2:' collides with ours again, one layer up. A conformant verifier must reject a v2 claim computed under any domain tag other than the one this spec defines -- the tag itself, not just its presence, is part of the profile.
